REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 27, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87386843028
MEETING ID # 873 8684 3028
*THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER IS CLOSED FOR THIS MEETING. THE MEETING WILL BE CONDUCTED VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY* INSTRUCTIONS FOR PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THIS MEETING ARE LISTED BELOW
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be closed to the public for this meeting. As authorized by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021), this meeting will be conducted via teleconference only. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after the distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or by connecting to the ZOOM meeting described below.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using any of the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: Live audio public comments can be made by connecting to the meeting using the information listed below. Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time during the meeting agenda and must be available at the time they are called upon to speak.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87386843028
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 873 8684 3028
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

This section is reserved for comments related to the Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and/or items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the legislative body. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.

Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the legislative body, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a legislative body member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7A.
Approval of Minutes

11.
Reports
11A.
Report from City Manager/Executive Director
During this part of the meeting the City Manager/Executive Director or designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior City Council meeting, including any request by the City Council to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior City Council meeting's agenda.
11B.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
12A.
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION

Title: City Manager

Closed Session Report
After the City Council/Successor Agency reconvenes into Open Session, designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken in Closed Session. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
13.
Adjournment
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
THURSDAY, JANUARY 27, 2022, 7:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED
ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (CHAPTER 165, STATUTES OF 2021), VIA ZOOM VIDEO
COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 873 8684 3028

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Dustin Parker, Concordia Lutheran Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Hu.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  None.

5B.  Informational update on the City's response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational report was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no further action taken on this item.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Audio public comments:

  Sam Desai expressed concerns with the City’s fiscal management.

  Jay Gray expressed concerns regarding the Charter Amendment Measures related to term
  limits and the City Facebook page comments policy.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 2 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, January 13, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Thursday, January
  13, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated January 27, 2022 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to approve the Register of Demands
  as follows:

  City of Cerritos  January 27, 2022  $ 3,385,720.75 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval to reject all bids for the C-2 booster pump station backup generator system
  replacement project, Bid No. 1447-22, and re-advertise the project with a revised project
  scope (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to reject all bids for Bid No. 1447-
  22, C-2 booster pump station backup generator system replacement project, and authorize
  staff to re-advertise the project with a revised project scope of work (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 3 of 7

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Recommendation of the Cerritos Planning Commission, on a vote of 5-0, to approve the
  following:

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVING AND CERTIFYING A NEGATIVE DECLARATION IN
  SUPPORT OF THE 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) (COUNCIL).

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL ADOPTING THE CITY OF CERRITOS 2021-2029 HOUSING
  ELEMENT OF THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Director of Community Development. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments period. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public
  comments period and public hearing closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1.  Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2022-11, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVING AND CERTIFYING A NEGATIVE
  DECLARATION IN SUPPORT OF THE 2021-2029 HOUSING ELEMENT IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA)
  (COUNCIL); and

  2.  Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2022-12, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL ADOPTING THE CITY OF CERRITOS 2021-2029
  HOUSING ELEMENT OF THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN (COUNCIL); and

  3.  Provide a report to the City Council on a future agenda for review and consideration of
  the appropriate zoning to maximize use for “Site 7,” as described in the agenda report.
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational budget and audit compliance report for Fiscal
  Year 2021-22 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager, and Dario Simoes, Deputy
  Director of Public Works/City Engineer. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 4 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9A.  (continued)

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Audio public comments:

  Jay Gray expressed concerns with inaccurate information presented related to the
  commencement of rental payments from Revolve for lease of the City-owned building and
  Cerritos residents’ rejection of Measure C. He requested a review of City fees.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Solanki, to ratify the executed
  budget amendments from the Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2021-2022, as summarized in
  the Budget Adjustment Log, as presented in the agenda report (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of a request by the American Association of University Women for
  the use of the City Council Chamber, associated City resources, and waiver of costs for the
  purpose of conducting a candidate forum relating to the Tuesday, April 12, 2022 Cerritos
  General Municipal Election (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Cynthia Nava, Assistant City Clerk. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Audio public comments:

  Jay Gray expressed concerns with potential conflict of interests if the organization’s
  members have personal relationships with members of the City Council or candidates in the
  April 12, 2022 Cerritos General Municipal Election.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the Mayor
  declared the public comments period closed.

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Barrows, to conditionally approve
  the request for use of the City Council Chamber by the American Association of University
  Women for the purpose of conducting a candidate forum on Tuesday, March 1, 2022, 7:00
  p.m. to 9:00 p.m. and waive all associated City costs, with the following provision:

  If the City Council Chamber is closed to the public due to the COVID-19 virus, the
  approved use of the City Council Chamber and City resources for the candidate
  forum will be canceled. This includes cancellation up to and through the date and
  time of the event (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a design concept by Gary Alsum for the proposed public art
  project that will pay tribute to the Public Safety (Sheriff and Fire) Services. The project will
  be constructed at the north entrance area of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station generally located
  on the northwest corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street, west of the Cerritos City
  Hall (APN 7025-028-905) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager, John Kinkade, the
  City’s design consultant, and Gary Alsum, the artist selected for the subject art piece. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  Discussion ensued between members of the City Council and the artist regarding various
  aspects of the proposed art concepts.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to table consideration of this
  item to a date certain, the Thursday, February 10, 2022, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor
  Agency Regular Meeting, to allow the artist to incorporate the comments and suggestions
  provided by the City Council for the proposed public art project that will pay tribute to the
  Public Safety (Sheriff and Fire) Services and present his updated design concepts for
  review and consideration (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to direct the artist to
  move forward with the lower cost Option 2 as presented in the agenda report, “Wall with
  Engraved Text” artwork, and incorporate all comments and suggestions provided by the
  City Council as directed in the previous motion for the proposed public art project that will
  pay tribute to the Public Safety (Sheriff and Fire) Services (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of the program for the temporary installation of sculptures in the
  Cerritos Sculpture Garden - generally located in the Cerritos Civic Center on the northwest
  corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street, west of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station (APN
  7028-028-904) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1.  Approve the recommendation from the Fine Arts and Historical Commission to:

  a. End the temporary art installation program in the Cerritos Sculpture Garden;
  and

  b. Purchase the art piece titled “Joker” by Jeff Zischke for the sum of $13,500; and

  c. Return the art piece titled “Flame” by Lyle London and seek an alternative art
  piece; and

  2. Compensate each of the artists (Jeff Zischke and Lyle London) the amount of $1,250
  each (a total $2,500) for the loaning of the artwork to the City for the period of
  February 2021 to February 2022, in accordance with the terms of the contract and
  provisions of the temporary art program (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Solanki, Yokoyama, Vo, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation.

  None.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, January 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting  Page 7 of 7

10.  Legislative Items (continued)

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  Reports

11A.  Report from City Manager/Executive Director

  None.

11B.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Meeting Reports

  Reports were given by Councilmembers Barrows, Solanki, and Yokoyama, Mayor Pro Tem
  Vo, and Mayor Hu.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to place a report on an upcoming City
  Council agenda for review and consideration of options to update the City’s Code
  Enforcement procedures, inclusive of potential amendments to the Cerritos Municipal Code.

  CONSENSUS (Barrows): Directed the City Manager to prepare a letter for the Mayor’s
  signature to be sent to the Metro Board expressing displeasure with their prohibition of
  additional public comment at their Thursday, January 27, 2022 meeting.

12.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, announced the City Council would not recess to Closed Session to
  discuss Items 12A, 12B, and 12C, as listed on the Closed Session agenda:

  12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

  12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk/Treasurer

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 10:49 p.m.

  /s/ Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
ATTEST:

  /s/ Grace Hu
Grace Hu, Mayor/Chair

APPROVED: February 10, 2022
